data.title: Oral Sentence Studio
data.description: Use both new words in one complete sentence of your own.

challenges.sceneMeaning: The hungry bunny is very happy to find fresh leaves in the sunny garden.
acceptedSentences: The hungry bunny feels happy when eating in the sunny garden.
A hungry little bunny is happy near the green leaves.
Feeling hungry, the bunny looks happy in the garden.

challenges.sceneMeaning: The joyful girl felt curious while holding a big book in the library.
acceptedSentences: The joyful girl looked curious while holding a big book in the library.
Holding a big book makes the curious girl feel joyful.
A joyful girl is curious to read a big book in the library.

challenges.sceneMeaning: The swift yellow duck glides across the blue water.
acceptedSentences: The swift yellow duck glides over the blue water.
A swift duck glides gently past the green leaf.
Our swift little duck glides in the pool.
